actions.sql: SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE SUM(ol_quantity) FROM tpcc_10W.order_line WHERE UPPER(ol_dist_info) LIKE 'Z%' ORDER BY ol_delivery_d

poor_plan.evidence: EXPLAIN shows table scan on order_line with Filter on UPPER(ol_dist_info) and filesort on ol_delivery_d (type=ALL)

success_criteria: During injection, EXPLAIN for the statement shows table scan (type=ALL) on order_line with rows examined in the millions
p95 latency increases by >= 1.5x versus baseline on the tpcc workload
Overall QPS drops to <= 70% of baseline during the injection window
missing_index_ol_scan.risk_assessment: Full scans on order_line (~9.5M rows) at concurrency 6 may cause IO and CPU spikes and increase lock waits for TPCC writers. Monitor Threads_running and abort if saturation causes errors.
